item.title: Explanations: What does it mean for humans, for machines, for man-machines interactions?
item.description: Paper presented at the Explainable Agency in AI Workshop, hosted by the 35th AAAI conference. It presents a quick review of explanation in the social sciences and in the AI communities, and proposes to move towards a User eXplainable Artificial Intelligence model (UXAI) to place the user at the center of the explanation process.
